accuracy.body_dimensions: Official metric chassis dimensions. Radius and edge roll photoestimated; not OEM CAD.
accuracy.screen_geometry: Official full-rectangle diagonal and native pixel aspect. Centered punch hole, bezels and corner radius photoestimated.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Camera centers and outer clear windows fitted to front-on official rear render. Bumps, optical internals, glass and rings approximate; not manufacturer CAD.
accuracy.glyphs: Photo-fitted physical strip paths and widths, unlit diffuse surfaces. Phone 3 Matrix is a simplified inactive circular dot array; Phone 4a six white zones plus red indicator. No invented lit symbols.
accuracy.finishes: Official finish names; existing Documents sRGB palette, finish-tinted logo retained via make_device_branding. Uncalibrated PBR approximation.
accuracy.branding: Restrained reconstructed dot-matrix NOTHING mark, estimated size and position; tiny regulatory text omitted.
accuracy.omissions: Transparent internals reduced to low-contrast plates, coil traces and fasteners. Ports, antenna seams, microscopic circuits, actual translucency and programmable Glyph lighting omitted.

rear_reference.note: Photo fit, not measured CAD. Rear X mirrored into front-view model coordinates.
